_comment: Golden vectors for canonical_key v2 (D-18; docs/spec/engine.md §3). Pinned answers for the dual-implementation rule: the Python reference (src/metricmine/keys.py) is held to these in CI (tests/test_canonical_key.py); the SQL path (sha256(lower(to_json(...)))) is held to the payload and manifest vectors by the consistency test that lands with the engine. Generated at the Sitting H prep session; every payload and manifest vector was cross-verified against DuckDB 1.4.3 SQL before committing. canonical/normalized fields are the pre-hash serializations, kept legible for review and debugging.

payload.name: field_order_insensitive
payload.description: Same fields declared in reverse order produce the same key: payload keys sort by lowercased field name at serialization (emission-time property; to_json does not sort).

payload.name: case_insensitive_names_and_values
payload.description: Mixed-case field names and values lowercase into the same key.

payload.name: unicode_values
payload.description: Unicode lowercase parity (a-umlaut, sharp-s, u-umlaut) between Python str.lower() and DuckDB lower(), vector-verified (F-11).

payload.name: interior_whitespace_preserved
payload.description: Payload-path values keep interior whitespace; only the scalar path strips it (D-18).

payload.name: hyphen_preserved
payload.description: Hyphens survive canonicalization on every path (D-18 delta from 2023).

payload.name: decimal_scale_preserved
payload.description: DECIMAL(10,2) renders scale-preserving text: 2.50 never collapses to 2.5 (F-11).

payload.name: decimal_integral_scale
payload.description: Integral decimals keep declared scale: 5.00 stays 5.00.

payload.name: timestamp_render
payload.description: TIMESTAMP renders YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS; the interior space survives the payload path (F-11).

payload.name: null_included_as_null
payload.description: A declared field whose value is NULL appears as JSON null: include-as-null, decided at the engine spec (§3.3).

payload.name: boolean_render
payload.description: Booleans render true/false exactly as DuckDB casts them.

payload.name: negative_integer
payload.description: Negative integers render with the sign; cancellation quantities are the live case.

payload.name: empty_string_value
payload.description: Empty-string value round-trips; the empty-string digest was byte-verified against hashlib at the probe (F-11).

payload.name: quote_escape_parity
payload.description: Embedded double quotes escape identically in Python json.dumps and DuckDB to_json.

payload.name: line_identity_regular
payload.description: The form-(b) derived degenerate identity over the declared silver grain tuple (invoice_id, stock_code, quantity, unit_price), a regular sales line.

payload.name: line_identity_cancellation
payload.description: The form-(b) derived identity for a cancellation line: C-prefixed invoice, negative quantity.

manifest.name: dim_manifest_v1
manifest.description: The mapping contract v1.0.0 dimension-payload manifest in declared order: five dimension-role fields plus the derived line_identity.

manifest.name: dim_manifest_v1_reversed
manifest.description: The same names reversed: manifests are ORDER-SENSITIVE by design (declared order, never sorted); this key must differ from dim_manifest_v1.

manifest.name: measure_manifest_v1
manifest.description: The mapping contract v1.0.0 measure manifest in declared order.

manifest.name: manifest_case_insensitive
manifest.description: Mixed-case names lowercase into the same manifest key.

scalar.name: scalar_empty_string
scalar.description: sha256 of the empty string: the digest byte-verified against Python hashlib at the live probe (F-11).

scalar.name: scalar_whitespace_stripped
scalar.description: The scalar path removes ALL whitespace (spaces, tabs) after lowercasing.

scalar.name: scalar_hyphen_preserved
scalar.description: Hyphens preserved on the scalar path (D-18 delta from 2023).

scalar.name: scalar_decimal_scale
scalar.description: Scalar decimals render scale-preserving before hashing.
